## Location
> File path and line number, or a URL.

- File:

## What is wrong
> Quote the current text, then describe the problem.

## What it should say
> The corrected wording, or the fact you are unsure about.

## Kind
- [ ] Contradicts the implementation
- [ ] Translation mismatch between the English and Chinese pair
- [ ] Broken or stale link

- [ ] Other

## Checked against
- [ ] The source file the doc describes, at commit:
- [ ] The other language of the same document
